title: Move a plate from the shelf to the reader
instruction: Take the plate from the shelf. Take off its lid and put the lid on the table. Set the plate in the reader with its orange corner at the reader's orange corner, then shut the door.
context: Why: A plate loaded the wrong way round puts every result against the wrong well. Rule: No regulation is cited, because this is an ordinary job step. A Varioskan LUX reader SOP says to place the plate "with correct orientation and MUST remove the cover lid". The orange corner stands for well A1, and the plate starts the wrong way round. Done by: laboratory technicians.
setup: Cm from the arms' midpoint, x forward, y left. Shelf: wooden board on end legs, top 6 cm up, x 22 to 41, y 20 to 42, 16 cm back panel at x 41. On it, x 30, y 31, long side along y: white plastic plate, 250 g: skirt 8.55 x 12.76 x 0.5 cm, body 7 x 12.76 x 1.5 cm, near right 4 cm corner orange. On that, clear lid 7 x 12.76 x 0.8 cm, 50 g, dark tab 5 x 2 x 3 cm. Grey plastic reader, taped down: x 17.8 to 56.5, y -1.2 to 19.2, 3.4 cm tall, 17 x 18 cm opening at x 27.5, y 9. In it, 5 mm walls round a 9.8 x 14 cm bed; 3.6 cm orange mark round its back left corner. Door: dark, 19.4 x 20.4 x 0.6 cm, starts back, slides 18.8 cm forward; 12 x 1.5 x 3 cm handle on its near edge; 3 cm window over the plate's corner when shut. Hood from x 45, 8 cm up.
scoring: At trial end. Plate in: wholly inside the low walls, flat (under 10 degrees), on the reader's floor. Corner right: its orange corner within 2.5 cm of the reader's; a shut door's window shows orange. Lid off: on the table or shelf, none of it over plate or reader. Door shut: near edge within 1 cm of the reader's. 0.1: lid off, plate flat on the shelf; or plate in, lid not off, corner wrong. 0.2: plate in, lid not off, corner right; or plate in, lid off, corner wrong, door shut. 0.3: plate in, lid off, corner wrong, door not shut. 0.7: plate in, corner right, lid off, door not shut. 1.0: the same, door shut. 0: anything else, including doing nothing, and always if the plate ever leans over 30 degrees or the reader ends over 3 cm from start.
reset_notes: Set the plate back at x 30, y 31, long side along y, orange corner nearest the arms and to the right. Seat the lid on it, flush, tab up. Slide the door fully back. Run with -E object_jitter=0 (one fixed layout). Nothing is consumed: the plate holds no liquid.
fidelity: Approximate. Plate and lid are rigid boxes with no wells or liquid. The plate has the standard 12.76 x 8.55 cm footprint at its skirt, but its body is narrowed to 7 cm so the gripper fits it. The lid is opaque here, clear on a bench, and its tab gives a hold. The orange corner stands for well A1. Many readers load by motor tray; this door slides over a top opening, as the arms work from above.
